scripts.text: I want to change my job to Swordman.

scripts.translation: 完成全部考验后，负责考验你的骑士们会齐聚一堂，评议你的表现。

scripts.text: The Knights must unanimously approve of you before you can join the Prontera Chivalry. If only one person objects, you must

scripts.translation: 不过，我相信，只要你怀着诚心坚持到底，必能获得骑士们的认可，成为我们骑士团的一员。

scripts.text: So, let's not waste any more time talking! Go and meet these Knights and begin their tests. Once you have completed all of the tests, come back to me.
scripts.translation: 好了，不再多说，去拜访那些骑士，开始考验吧！全部完成后，再回来找我。

scripts.translation: ..！我不想给你压力，慢慢考虑吧。准备好转职后

scripts.text: I wish to take the test again.
A Knight must possess great strength, defense, speed, and the skill to wield a Two-Handed Sword. Which of the following weapons are not affected by the Two Hand Quicken skill?
scripts.translation: 骑士要有强大的力量、防御与速度，也要熟练掌握双手剑。以下哪种武器不受双手剑攻击速度增加技能的影响？

scripts.translation: 真想当骑士吗？连基本知识都不懂...

scripts.text: If you're not sure about anything, go into town and ask any Knight. You need to learn more about Knights before applying for the job!
scripts.translation: 不懂的就去城里找骑士请教。申请转职前，先多了解一下骑士！

scripts.text: Wrong! You need to learn that to learn Brandish Spear! How can you not know about Knights if you want to become one?
scripts.translation: 错！学习骑乘攻击，必须先学会那个技能！想当骑士，怎么能不了解骑士呢？

scripts.text: If you aren't sure about anything, go into town and ask any Knight
scripts.translation: 不懂的就去城里找骑士请教。多了

scripts.translation: 解一些骑士的知识，再回来吧。

scripts.text: Some Spears also have magical attributes, just like spells. Of the following, which can attack a Nightmare, which has the Ghost attribute?

scripts.text: Wrong! You'll be doing absolutely no damage with that type of Spear! Come back after you've learned more about Knights!

scripts.translation: 当了骑士，就能骑乘大嘴鸟。不过，骑上大嘴鸟后，攻击速度会下降。

scripts.text: But, you can counter this speed decrease as you learn the Cavalier Mastery skill. What percentage of your normal attack speed will you have after learning Level 3 Cavalier Mastery?
scripts.translation: 学习骑兵修炼，能抵消骑乘时的攻击速度下降。学到3级后，攻击速度是正常速度的百分之多少？

scripts.text: Don't bother riding a Peco Peco if you don't know about Cavalier Mastery!
scripts.translation: 连骑兵修炼都不了解，还骑什么大嘴鸟！

scripts.text: You better come back after you've learned a little more about Knights!
scripts.translation: 先去多了解一下骑士，再回来吧！

scripts.text: I'm pretty sure you know a decent amount about Knights. Now, let me ask you some personal questions about Knights.
scripts.translation: ...看来你对骑士已经相当了解了。接下来，问几个关于骑士的问题，听听你个人的想法。

scripts.text: What should you do when you run into a Novice asking for help in town?
scripts.translation: 在城里遇到求助的初心者，你该怎么做？

scripts.text: Tell the Novice of a reasonable hunting area.
scripts.translation: 告诉初心者合适的狩猎地点

scripts.text: Let the Novice fight while you take the damage.
scripts.translation: 让初心者战斗，自己承受伤害

scripts.text: Give the Novice a bunch of Zeny and items.
Of course, even a Novice needs to learn how to be independent. Giving good guidance to Novices is one of the best things we can do.
scripts.translation: 没错，初心者也得学会独立。给他们正确的指引，是我们能做的最好的帮助之一。

scripts.text: You have the wrong idea. Do you really believe that is helping the Novice? Give a man a fish, he will eat for a day. Teach him to fish, he will eat for a lifetime!
scripts.translation: 想错了。你真觉得这样是在帮初心者吗？授人以鱼，不如授人以渔！

scripts.text: Do you really believe that this will truly help the poor Novice? It's generous but, they will not know the true value of zeny and items until they earn it themselves.
scripts.translation: 你真觉得这样能帮到那个可怜的初心者？虽然慷慨，可只有靠自己挣来的Zeny和物品，才能让他们明白其中的价值。

scripts.text: Protect everyone in the front of the battle.
scripts.translation: 站在战斗前线保护大家

scripts.text: Gather monsters and destroy them at once.
scripts.translation: 把魔物聚在一起，一举消灭

scripts.text: Get as many items possible, at all cost.
scripts.translation: 不惜代价，尽可能多拿物品

scripts.text: That's it! Our strength and attacks are very important in a party. All Knights should engage in a battle with that mindset.
scripts.translation: 没错！在队伍里，我们的力量和攻击很重要。每位骑士都应抱着这种心态战斗。

scripts.text: Are you crazy? Don't you realize the flaw in that kind of thinking? You can't control large mobs. What if they kill you? Who will protect the innocent?
scripts.translation: 疯了吗？没想过这样做有什么问题？魔物太多，你根本控制不住。万一你死了，谁来保护无辜的人？

scripts.translation: 看得出你很贪婪，我们这里容不下这种人！你根本不关心别人！

scripts.text: Right, above all else, Knights must be honorable! We live and die for honor! Always keep that in mind.
scripts.translation: 对，骑士最重要的是守护荣誉！我们为荣誉而生，为荣誉而死！一定要铭记。

scripts.text: You're scum! You strive to become a Knight for personal wealth? Get lost! We will not accept someone like you in our Chivalry!
scripts.translation: 人渣！想当骑士，只是为了发财？滚！骑士团不会接纳你这种人！

scripts.text: So you're trying to become famous through the Chivalry? That's pathetic. We won't accept someone like you in our Chivalry!
scripts.translation: 想借骑士团扬名？真可悲。我们不会接纳你这种人！

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
You already took my test, didn't you? You're done here. You should go visit Sir Windsor now...
scripts.translation: ..你不是已经接受过我的考验了吗？我这里已经结束了，去找温莎爵士吧...

scripts.text: Sorry, but I'm busy at the moment. You should go and finish the rest of your tests.
scripts.translation: 吗？抱歉，我现在很忙。先去完成剩下的考验吧。

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
What kind of test is this?
How do I take the test?

scripts.translation: 欢迎来到普隆德拉骑士团~

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
You applied to change jobs! Okay! You'll soon be a Knight with that kind of determination!
scripts.translation: ~你申请转职了！好呀，有这份决心，很快就能当上骑士！

scripts.text: a proud Lady Knight of the Prontera Chivalry. Amy's test will test your etiquette as a Knight~
scripts.translation: 丝，是普隆德拉骑士团引以为荣的女骑士。艾米要考考你身为骑士的礼仪~

scripts.text: I'll tell you a story and you choose an answer whenever
scripts.translation: 我会讲个故事，每次提问，你都要选一个答

scripts.text: I ask a question. Your etiquette will be judged on your answers.
scripts.translation: 案。我会根据你的回答，判断你是否懂得礼仪。

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
You are a Knight and you are looking for a party in Morocc.
scripts.translation: 假设你是一名骑士，正在梦罗克找队伍

scripts.text: How would you go about doing so?
You are a Knight and you are looking for a party in Morocc.
scripts.translation: 假设你是一名骑士，正在梦罗克找队伍

scripts.text: How would you go about doing so?
Shout out that you are looking for a party.
scripts.translation: 大声喊话，表示自己在找队伍

scripts.text: Open a chat room and wait.
You have formed a party with equal leveled players. There's a Priest, a Wizard, a Hunter, an Assassin, and a Blacksmith...
scripts.translation: 你和等级相近的玩家组成了队伍。队里有牧师、巫师、猎人、刺客和铁匠...

scripts.text: The six of you decide to go hunt and have decided to go to the Pyramids.
scripts.translation: 你们六人决定一起狩猎，目的地是金字塔。

scripts.text: Check out the area and plan ahead.
scripts.translation: 观察周围，提前制定计划

scripts.text: Gather monsters for your party members.
Lead the party slowly at the front.
scripts.translation: 走在前方，带队缓慢前进

scripts.text: But some rude players came with a group of monsters and disappeared! What should you do?
scripts.translation: 这时，几个没礼貌的玩家引来一群魔物，自己却消失了！你该怎么做？

scripts.text: Keep the monsters from reaching the party.
Run away on your Peco Peco.
Luckily, you all lived through the crisis. But as you walk, you find a person, who is not in your party, collapsed on the ground.
scripts.translation: 幸好，大家平安度过了危机。继续前进时，你们发现一个不属于队伍的人倒在地上。

scripts.text: The person is asking politely for help. What should you do?
scripts.translation: 那个人礼貌地向你们求助。你该怎么做？

scripts.text: Ask your party's Priest to help.
Say you will help for Zeny.
You must bid farewell to your party members because you must go somewhere else.
scripts.translation: 你要去别的地方，只好向队友告别。

scripts.text: Give it to who deserves it the most.
Pretend like nothing happened and keep it.
scripts.translation: 假装什么都没发生，自己留下

scripts.text: Decide with party who gets it.
You end up with the item and you go to Prontera to sell it. There are many people with shops and chat rooms opened selling items.
scripts.translation: 最后，物品归了你。你去普隆德拉卖掉它，那里有很多人开着商店或聊天室出售物品。

scripts.text: Open a chat room and wait.
Inquire if there is anyone that is interested.
Give them some Zeny and items.
Give suggestions for a place to hunt.
Now you decide to go to the Hidden Temple by yourself. You happily ride on your Peco Peco.
scripts.translation: 接着，你决定独自去隐藏神殿，开心地骑着大嘴鸟出发了。

scripts.text: Tell the person how to reach the exit.
Lead the person to the exit.
You've been hunting for a while, and now you're low on HP!
scripts.translation: 狩猎了一阵后，你的HP已经很低了！

scripts.text: It's red now, which is very dangerous.
Would it be possible to get a heal please?
scripts.translation: 请问可以麻烦您帮我治疗一下吗？

scripts.text: Pick it up and keep it.
Ask around to find the owner.
Well done, that kind of mentality is needed for a Knight! For your next test, visit Sir Edmond, please~
scripts.translation: 做得好，骑士就该有这样的心态！下一项考验，去找埃德蒙爵士吧~

scripts.text: I'll have nice comments about you for the captain. Do well on the tests you have left, okay?
scripts.translation: 我会在团长面前好好夸夸你。剩下的考验也要好好表现哦？

scripts.text: but I think you know enough
scripts.translation: 美，但你已经懂得足够的

scripts.text: Now, it's time for you to go to Sir Edmond for your next test. Do well on the rest of your tests. You better promise~
scripts.translation: 现在去找埃德蒙爵士，接受下一项考验吧。后面的考验也要好好表现，答应我哦~

scripts.text: To be honest, I don't think your attitude is good enough to be a Knight quite yet.
scripts.translation: ..说实话，你现在的态度，还不太适合当骑士。

scripts.text: If you really act like that, everyone will think Knights are rude! Think about how you answered my questions and come again later.
scripts.translation: 真要那样做，大家都会觉得骑士没礼貌！好好想想刚才的回答，过会儿再来。

scripts.text: Trees with deep roots don't sway with the wind. The fact that powerful skills must be built on strong basics is immutable...
scripts.translation: 根深的树，不会随风摇摆。强大的技艺必须建立在牢固的基础上，这是不变的道理...

scripts.text: Everything in this world exists in harmony. Living without disrupting this harmony is the right way to live...
scripts.translation: 世间万物和谐共存。顺应这份和谐，而不破坏它，才是正确的生存之道...

scripts.text: Those with ominous thoughts will only dream such dreams. It's better to have no dreams at all than to have dreams of sadness and despair.
scripts.translation: 心怀不祥之念，梦中也只有不祥。与其梦见悲伤和绝望，不如无梦。

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
A seed must first be nestled
in the earth before the seed may sprout. Then, the sprout must grow leaves before its buds blossom into flowers...
scripts.translation: 中，才能萌芽。嫩芽先长出叶子，花蕾才能绽放...
有什么事吗...流浪的剑士。

scripts.text: It is now time to take my test. Please do your best, as you have done on the other tests.
scripts.translation: 现在，该接受我的考验了。像之前一样，全力以赴吧。

scripts.text: Knights are in the position for others to follow. Therefore, you must modestly think about the world's order and have the personality to fit the role you will play.
scripts.translation: 骑士是他人追随的榜样。因此，你应谦逊地思考世间的秩序，修养与身份相称的品格。

scripts.text: You must not make careless decisions. Your will should bend as the reeds or be as firm as stone when the situation calls for it.
scripts.translation: 不可草率决断。应变通时，如芦苇般柔韧；应坚持时，如磐石般坚定。

scripts.text: You must not kill monsters without reason and not take joy in doing so. Take this time to quietly think about this on your own...
scripts.translation: 不可无故杀戮魔物，更不可引以为乐。趁这段时间，独自静心思考吧...

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to...
You were too careless in the last test. A Knight's sword exists to protect others, not to torment weaker monsters.
scripts.translation: 上次考验，你太草率了。骑士的剑，是为了保护他人，不是为了欺凌弱小的魔物。

scripts.text: In a world where everything exists in harmony, you can't have humans continuously destroying without purpose. This principle applies to the real world, not to this test alone.
scripts.translation: 世间万物和谐共存，人类不可无休止地肆意破坏。这个道理，不只适用于考验，也适用于现实。

scripts.text: I have seen your character for myself. It is now time for you to take the last test. Go and speak
scripts.translation: 我已亲眼见识你的品行。该接受最后一项考验了，去找格

scripts.text: that shines off this blade cannot be put into words. This is the weapon every Knight must have.
scripts.translation: 的光芒，实在难以言喻。每位骑士都该拥有这样的武器。

scripts.text: Claymore, one of the best among the famous swords you can attain in Rune-Midgarts' Prontera!! Its value is priceless when considered by a Knight.
scripts.translation: 双手剑，是卢恩·米德加兹王国普隆德拉能买到的名剑中最出色的几把之一！对骑士而言，它可是无价之宝。

scripts.text: Now, the Prontera Chivalry is making these fabulous Claymores. For Knights, they are only ^3355FF74,000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 如今，普隆德拉骑士团正在打造这些精美的双手剑。骑士购买，只要74,000 Zeny。 ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: But not only that, you need
1 ^3355FFSteel^000000 because of the Claymore's characteristics. If you like, I can create one for you. For the honor of the Prontera Chivalry!
scripts.translation: 性，还需要1个钢铁。愿意的话，我可以替你打造一把。为了普隆德拉骑士团的荣誉！ ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: It seems that you are carrying too many things. You don't have enough space for a heavy Claymore in your inventory.
scripts.translation: ...你带的东西太多，背包装不下沉重的双手剑了。

scripts.text: It'll be a good companion on your adventures.
scripts.translation: 武器值得信赖，会成为你冒险时的好伙伴。

scripts.text: I realize you may really want a Claymore, but I can't make it without the materials.
scripts.translation: 我知道你很想要双手剑，可没有材料，我也造不出来。需要74,000 Zen

scripts.text: Any Knight should be able to wield a Claymore as if it were an extension of their body. I used to look forward to brandishing my Claymore in battle...
scripts.translation: 骑士应该把双手剑使得如同自己的手脚一般。我以前也总盼着在战场上挥舞双手剑...

scripts.text: I never really planned to become a Knight, but I did decide to become a strong person. Somehow, along my journeys, I ended up joining the Prontera Chivalry. Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation: 我原本没打算当骑士，只是想成为强者。不知不觉，旅途中就加入了普隆德拉骑士团。哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
Because I'm unsatisfied with myself right now...
scripts.translation: 因为我不满现在的自己...

scripts.text: Is it to show off to others? To attain fame? Or do you have a diferent reason? What do you think is so good about gaining strength as a Knight?
scripts.translation: 为了向别人炫耀？为了扬名？还是另有原因？你认为获得骑士的力量，有什么好处？

scripts.text: Of course, wealth and fame have their place in the world. But we as Knights must live for higher virtues.
scripts.translation: 当然，财富与名声自有其价值。但身为骑士，我们应为更高尚的美德而活。

scripts.text: Good thinking. You must first be able to protect yourself in order to protect others. To this end, you must constantly train, and never give in to laziness.
scripts.translation: 想得好。先能保护自己，才能保护别人。因此，必须勤加训练，绝不懈怠。

scripts.text: Ah, a wonderful idea. A Knight's strength must be used to protect the weak and defend righteousness.
scripts.translation: 啊，想得很好。骑士的力量，应该用来保护弱小、捍卫正义。

scripts.text: Sadly, there are a few Knights who shame us by forgetting the ideals that should be basic to Knighthood...
scripts.translation: 令人遗憾的是，有些骑士忘记了骑士道的基本准则，令我们蒙羞...

scripts.text: Ah, to help your guild, or maybe even your party. Our wise and benevolent King Tristram the 3rd gave us these golden words...
scripts.translation: 啊，为了帮助公会，也可能是队伍。英明仁慈的特里斯拉姆三世国王，曾赐予我们这样一句金玉良言...

scripts.text: ^8B7500Beyond the calm river, lies a dangerous waterfall. Therefore, you must always be prepared for everything...^000000
scripts.translation: 平静河流的前方，也可能有危险的瀑布。因此，凡事都应时刻做好准备... ^8B7500^000000

scripts.text: I can help gather funds for my guild.
I can protect my guild members.
has a place where they are needed. Never neglect someone in need, even if he is not a guild member.
scripts.translation: 需要自己的地方。不要忽视求助的人，即使对方不是公会成员。

scripts.text: But we Knights must live for higher virtues.
scripts.translation: 骑士，我们应为更高尚的美德而活。

scripts.text: Ah, a wonderful idea. A Knight's strength must be used to protect the weak and defend righteousness.
scripts.translation: 啊，想得很好。骑士的力量，应该用来保护弱小、捍卫正义。

scripts.text: Sadly, there are a few Knights who shame us by forgetting the ideals that should be basic to Knighthood...
scripts.translation: 令人遗憾的是，有些骑士忘记了骑士道的基本准则，令我们蒙羞...

scripts.text: Is there a particular reason you wish to be a Knight?
scripts.translation: 了。有什么特别的理由，让你想当骑士？

scripts.text: Swordmen, but Knights do not allow self-indulgence. There are those so obsessed with gaining strength that they cannot control themselves.
scripts.translation: 我不清楚，但骑士绝不能放纵自己。有人执迷于追求力量，甚至失去了自制。

scripts.text: Skill is something you gain with experience as a Knight. It cannot be your highest goal. Otherwise, you'll never be satisfied as a Knight.
scripts.translation: 当了骑士，技艺自然会随着经验增长。它不该是你最高的目标。否则，即使成了骑士，你也永远不会满足。

scripts.text: Always having a goal is very important. You may be full of ideas upon becoming a Knight, but that may change with time.
scripts.translation: 了...始终有个目标，非常重要。刚当上骑士时，你也许有许多想法，不过，它们也会随着时间改变。

scripts.text: What you see isn't what really counts. A Swordman may be stronger than a Knight, and even Knight may grow weak if he becomes lazy.
scripts.translation: ...眼睛看到的，并非真正重要的东西。剑士也可能比骑士强，骑士一旦懈怠，也会变得弱小。

scripts.text: but there are those who wish to
Those are the ones who instigate problems and shame the honor of Knights, bringing irreversible results.
scripts.translation: 正是这种人惹是生非，玷污骑士的荣誉，酿成无法挽回的后果。

scripts.text: The same goes for you as well. Once you become a Knight, you can never become a Swordman again. The duties and responsibilities of a Knight will always be with you.
scripts.translation: 你也一样。一旦成了骑士，就不能再变回剑士。骑士的职责与责任，将始终伴随你。

scripts.text: If you become a Knight right away, what are you going to do first?
scripts.translation: 如果现在就成为骑士，你会先做什么？

scripts.text: I am going to go straight to battle.
There are those waiting for me.
I will learn more about Knights.
I will grow within a short period of time.
I would like to test my ability as a Knight.
scripts.translation: 检验自己身为骑士的能力

scripts.text: I would like to go to more challenging places.
Don't be in too much of a hurry to become strong. Even if you become
scripts.translation: 别急于变强。即使当了骑士，你

scripts.text: a Knight, you are still yourself.
Testing yourself is a good thing. It's okay to be happy about how you change, but don't forget about the true qualities of being a Knight.
scripts.translation: 检验自己是件好事。为自身的变化高兴，也无妨，但别忘了骑士应有的品格。

scripts.text: Even if you become a Knight, you are not changing your inner self. No need to overwork yourself.
scripts.translation: 成为骑士，并不会让你内在的自己改变。不必过分勉强，

scripts.text: Relax and take things step by step.
I see, they would share in the joy of your achievements. Don't ever lose your kind heart, and always give help to your friends.
scripts.translation: 我明白了，他们会为你的成就一同欢喜。要始终心怀善意，帮助朋友。

scripts.text: Those who would share in your happiness and hardship. As a Knight, you must always protect them.
scripts.translation: 与你同甘共苦的人。身为骑士，你应始终保护他们。

scripts.text: Comfortable places for Knights to go...
scripts.translation: 适合骑士去的舒适地方...

scripts.text: The different paths of a Knight...
Ways to get more money as a Knight...
There are many places that are comfortable or uncomfortable in this world. However Knights must
scripts.translation: 世上有舒适的地方，也有艰苦的地方。但骑士必须能在

scripts.text: There are many similar Knights outside in the world. Think of them as your seniors and ask many questions.
scripts.translation: 外面还有许多和你一样的骑士。把他们当作前辈，多多请教。

scripts.text: Oh no. Do you hold wealth as a priority of being a Knight? We're not meant to be that way. Come again when you have thought
scripts.translation: 哦，不。你把发财当成骑士的首要目标？我们不该如此。好好想想，再回

scripts.text: I enjoyed talking with you. You remind me of myself as a young recruit. Shall we talk to the captain and decide on your
scripts.translation: 和你聊得很愉快。你让我想起年轻时刚入团的自己。去找团长，决定你能否转

scripts.text: I enjoyed speaking with you. You can think about the principles of Knighthood more once you become a Knight.
scripts.translation: 和你交谈很愉快。成为骑士后，还可以继续思考骑士之道。

scripts.text: Then, shall we go to the captain and decide on your job change? Don't worry too much. You are good enough to be a Knight!
scripts.translation: 那么，去找团长，决定你能否转职吧？别太担心，你已经具备骑士的资格！

scripts.text: I enjoyed talking with you. Although, there were some
scripts.translation: 和你聊得很愉快。不过，有些地方还是

scripts.text: Don't worry too much, coming to take my test means the others have acknowledged you as well.
scripts.translation: 别太担心，能来接受我的考验，说明其他人也认可了你。去吧.

scripts.text: But it seems as though your dream is elsewhere, or that your focus is hazy. Spend more time as a Swordman, and come back
scripts.translation: 不过，你似乎另有所求，或是目标还不明确。再以剑士的身份磨炼一段时间，之后回

scripts.text: If you truly wish to become a Knight, you must change your outlook first. Then, we shall see.
scripts.translation: 真想当骑士，就得先改变想法。之后，再看看吧。

scripts.text: What can I do for you?
scripts.translation: 哦...年轻的剑士。有什么需要帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
